---
title: "A derived title bar is in the rendered page"
filters:
  - code-window
---

A block without a filename gets its title bar when the page renders, in the
same markup as a block with one, so nothing moves when the page loads.

```python
x = 1
```

```{.python filename="named.py"}
y = 2
```

```python
z = 3 # <1>
```

1. An annotation.

```{#lst-auto .python lst-cap="Auto listing"}
w = 4
```

```{.r code-fold="true"}
v <- 5
```

```{.python code-window-no-auto-filename="true"}
u = 6
```
